name: flock
description: Audit source evidence and compare synthetic social scenarios from inside Codex.

interface.longDescription: Turn source documents into an evidence-labeled knowledge graph, audit its source trail, and compare controlled synthetic community scenarios with interactive local replays. The active host session performs model reasoning, while each user configures their own host and provider access. Flock's model-free helper stores graph, audits, and experiment runs in the chosen workspace. No separate Flock API key, Zep key, external graph service, or local web app is required.
defaultPrompt: Use Flock to build a source-grounded graph or simulate a synthetic community in this workspace.
